verdict.rationale: Terraform's apply docs describe a first-party `-destroy` mode that creates a plan to destroy all remote objects. Apply executes its operations in the correct order, respecting resource dependencies, which supports a clean full-environment teardown. Coverage is limited to brief mentions in the apply page. missing for 10: dedicated in-depth documentation of the destroy workflow (e.g., a `terraform destroy` command page, failure/partial-destroy handling), independent or hands-on corroboration that teardowns complete cleanly.
